A CLEAR SEQUENCE OF STEPS

From the first brief to ongoing care.

Together we define the individual parts according to the scope of the contract.

    We discuss the type of property, its current condition and what you need to resolve.

    Technical solution

  3. 03

BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

What you may want to know.

Do you have a specific installation or brief? Let's go through it together.

+420 736 403 795
Do you also handle properties larger than family homes?+

Yes. We also provide WWTPs for guesthouses, hotels, leisure resorts, municipalities, commercial buildings and industrial facilities.

Can you deal with just part of the technology, or with an existing WWTP?+

Yes. Our range includes technology packages, related equipment, water treatment, and the refurbishment and modernisation of existing treatment plants. The specific scope is based on an assessment of the brief.

Do you also provide project preparation?+

Yes. We offer project preparation and technical advice. Depending on the scope, we use our own capacity and cooperating specialist partners.
